Step-by-Step ShelbyWin Casino Sign-Up

Setting up an account at Shelbywin Casino is straightforward and designed to get you playing safely without unnecessary steps.

How to Register an Account

To register on our website, you need to:

  1. Initiate Registration: Click the sign-up button located in the top navigation bar of our website.

  2. Provide Account Credentials: Enter a valid email address and create a strong password. Select GBP (£) as your default account currency.

  3. Enter Personal Information: Fill in your full name, date of birth, residential UK address, and mobile phone number.

  4. Confirm Terms: Review and accept our platform terms of service and confirm that you meet the legal gambling age requirement (18+).

  5. Account Activation: Verify your email address by clicking the confirmation link sent to your inbox.

Once registered, returning players can complete the Shelbywin login process by entering their registered email and password in the header login panel.

Account Verification (KYC) Process

To comply with international anti-money laundering (AML) regulations and ensure player security, Shelbywin enforces a standard Know Your Customer (KYC) policy. Account verification must be completed before processing large withdrawal requests or after reaching cumulative payout thresholds.

Verification requires submitting clear copies of the following documents through your secure profile section:

  • Proof of Identity: A valid passport, UK driving licence, or national identity card.

  • Proof of Address: A utility bill (gas, electricity, water) or bank statement issued within the last three months displaying your full name and address.

  • Proof of Payment Method: A photograph or screenshot of your payment card (showing only the first 6 and last 4 digits) or e-wallet profile page confirming ownership.

Our compliance team evaluates submitted documents within 24 to 48 hours. Once verified, account restrictions are lifted, ensuring unhindered withdrawal processing.
